visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with short dark hair and a dark floral print dress sits at a large light-colored wooden table. She holds a piece of bread to her mouth, biting into it while looking towards the camera. The background is a bright, modern kitchen featuring white cabinetry, a stainless steel refrigerator, and integrated ovens. (2) The camera moves closer to the toddler. She holds the bread in both hands, meticulously peeling off small pieces. Her facial expressions vary from concentration to a broad, happy smile. Yellow and white text captions appear at the bottom center of the screen intermittently. (3) The toddler extends her empty hands toward the camera; a hand from an off-screen adult enters the frame to place a fresh piece of bread into her palms. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the wood and the child's clothing. (4) The toddler reacts with intense joy, laughing loudly and patting the wooden tabletop with both hands. Her eyes are squinted in happiness as she continues to chew. Small bread crumbs are visible on the table and her face. The camera maintains a medium-close-up framing. (5) The scene transitions to a light yellow background with a small cartoon illustration of a girl and a boy. Below the illustration, the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' is displayed in a simple black font. The overall lighting remains flat and graphic in this final segment.

The toddler's vocalizations transition into high-frequency, high-arousal squeals and rhythmic laughter, which peaks in intensity. The percussive elements of the music are synchronized with her movements.
